counterfactual_missing_items: Pathergy test or HLA-B51 (expected in Behçet's disease)
decisive_items: Monomorphic, perivascular, and periadnexal atypical lymphocytic infiltrate
Epidermal necrosis with numerous fibrin thrombi and intra-/perivascular atypical lymphocytic infiltrate showing monotony and hyperchromasia
Immunohistochemical staining: CD3-positive T cells coexpressing CD4 and CD8 with preserved expression of CD7
response.rationale: R4 is strongly supported by raw pathological and immunohistochemical findings specific to cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, including atypical lymphocytic infiltrate and CD3/CD4/CD8 coexpression. R2 relies on ulcer morphology but lacks the diagnostic biopsy evidence; R3 and R5 have no raw support or only nonspecific symptoms.

rejected.why: Only raw support is oral/vaginal ulcerations, which are not specific to Behçet's and contradicted by the lymphocytic biopsy findings.
No raw support spans; only generator assessments, and the biopsy shows lymphocytic infiltrate rather than vasculitis.
